text: This report responds to direction to staff from the Board at its September 6, 2018 meeting to provide an analysis of the Real Asset allocation in the Council-approved Investment Policy.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Requested the Executive Director, Corporate Finance and the Investment Consultant, Aon Hewitt take the necessary steps to implement City Council's Investment Policy in regards to Real Assets, based on the assurances within the staff report that the City's operational assets were taken into consideration when City Council adopted the Investment Policy.
